repo.description:
### Impact

A public shared collective always allowed recipients of the link to create pages.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Collectives app is upgraded to 4.4.0

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References


* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3533697)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/collectives/pull/2477)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Public collectives allow to create pages
